title: Ollama: Local LLM Runtime & API
summary: Ollama simplifies running large language models (LLMs) locally on your machine, providing a user-friendly command-line interface and a robust API. It enables users to easily download, create, and manage a wide range of models for chat, text generation, and embeddings. For developers, Ollama offers a powerful platform to integrate local AI capabilities into applications, fostering innovation and privacy.
